b.x: In a long blackout, a flood, or a stopped street, diarrhea and infection drop a household faster than missing rice. Real survivalism treats waste, trash, and dirty hands as priority — not a detail. The gray man does not build a latrine in the building hall. He solves it with a bucket, a lid, bags, lime, and what the law and the building allow.
Soap, 70% alcohol, paper, pads, nappies if there is a child — 14 days on the island.
A lidded bucket and bags for the bowl if the flush dies. Do not throw trash in the bowl ‘to see’.
Trash: tie, isolate, put it out on the right day. Smell in the hall is a poster and it is health.
Flood water is not for bathing or a cup. Mud enters wounds. Boots, gloves, tetanus current at the clinic — not on a forum.
01 Separate drinking water from wash water. This guide’s calculator counts minimal hygiene.
02 Hands: soap if there is water; alcohol if water is short. Before food, after the bowl.
03 Do not dig a pit in the building yard. The condo and public health exist. Gray does not become a focus.
